articles.summary: Northern California leg of Archer’s No Roads Tour wraps up as Midnight heads south to Los Angeles Archer's all-electric Midnight air taxi recently completed a week filled with piloted flights across Northern California, including multiple flights around the San Francisco Bay that took off and landed at Oakland International Airport. ( Watch Video ) The Bay Area flights capped Archer’s month-long Northern California leg of its ‘No Roads’ flight tour showcasing its Midnight air taxi making stops in Hollister, San Martin, San Jose, Mountain View and Hayward before arriving in Oakland. The purpose of the Northern California leg of Archer’s ‘No Roads’ tour was to showcase Midnight’s ability to operate seamlessly in complex urban airspace surrounding the Bay Area's three international airports — San Francisco, Oakland and San Jose. These flights set the stage for Midnight to continue demonstrating its readiness to integrate with commercial air traffic across the world’s largest cities –
articles.title: Archer Completes Historic Electric Air Taxi Flights Over San Francisco Bay
